title: losos-ctl wire format
description: JSON schemas for the losos-ctl backend, as invoked by the losos Nextcloud app over `sudo -n losos-ctl <subcommand>`. Every subcommand prints exactly one JSON object on stdout, terminated by a newline.

mode.description: local = private Nextcloud (sharingMyStorage=false); mesh = contributes storage to the Tahoe grid (sharingMyStorage=true).

rebuildState.description: Lifecycle of the last/current nixos-rebuild triggered by `change`.

job.description: Opaque id returned by `change`; referenced by the detached rebuild watcher.

progress.description: 0 while building (coarse); 100 on success. Optional on the persisted state file (defaults to 0); always present in the status wire response.

message.description: Human-readable status; on failure includes the last nixos-rebuild log line. Optional on the persisted state file (defaults to empty); always present in the status wire response.

settingsResponse.description: The user-tunable losos.* options parsed out of modules/overrides.nix (line-based). Returned by `settings`; consumed by the admin app for first paint.

job.description: Opaque id of the rebuild triggered to apply the reset.

reset.description: Always true; distinguishes the factory-reset ack from a change ack.

stateFile.description: The persisted state at $LOSOS_STATE_DIR/state.json. Internal to the backend; not a wire response.

state.description: `losos-ctl state --json` — current mode + sharing flag. stdout: stateResponse.

change.description: `losos-ctl change --mode <local|mesh>` — rewrite the flake's sharingMyStorage line, mark a rebuild as building, spawn a detached nixos-rebuild. Returns immediately. stdout: changeResponse. Non-zero exit + stderr on invalid mode.

status.description: `losos-ctl status --json` — rebuild progress, polled by the PHP app ~every 2s. stdout: statusResponse.

settings.description: `losos-ctl settings --json` — the user-tunable losos.* options parsed from modules/overrides.nix. stdout: settingsResponse.

apply.description: `losos-ctl apply` — read Nix code (a full modules/overrides.nix body) from stdin, validate it references losos.* and is a module body, atomically overwrite modules/overrides.nix, mark a rebuild as building, spawn a detached nixos-rebuild switch, and emit the job id on stdout. The PHP admin app generates the Nix code from the form and pipes it in. Non-zero exit + stderr on validation failure (so the PHP layer raises BackendException).

stdin.description: The full overrides.nix body the admin app generated.

factory-reset.description: `losos-ctl factory-reset` — soft factory reset: atomically restore modules/overrides.nix to the committed default body, reset the persisted state to defaultState (Local, sharing off), mark a rebuild as building, spawn a detached nixos-rebuild, and emit the job id. Non-destructive: it only touches losos-ctl's own state + overrides.nix. The destructive tier (wipe disks + reinstall) is the installer ISO, which auto-runs `losos-install` as root's login shell.

install.description: `losos-ctl install [flags]` — the losos auto-installer (was losos-install.sh). Detects fixed disks, merges them into one LVM volume group via disko, runs nixos-install, and lays the flake at /persist/etc/nixos. Flags: --tpm, --drives A,/dev/b,..., --no-install, --disko-script PATH, --emit-target FILE. Drives auto-detection uses `lsblk --json`. Non-zero exit + stderr on failure (no candidate disks, disko/nixos-install failure).

rebuild-done.description: `losos-ctl rebuild-done <exitcode> <job>` — internal, invoked by the detached rebuild shell after nixos-rebuild. Updates stateFile.rebuild to done/failed only if <job> matches the currently-tracked rebuild's id (a stale completion from an older, superseded rebuild is ignored). No stdout contract.

job.description: The job id returned by the `change` that started this rebuild.
